Privacy.sec1Desc: Welcome to Portfo.be. Your privacy is our top priority. This Privacy Policy comprehensively explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our portfolio building platform services. By accessing and using Portfo.be, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
Privacy.sec2Desc: We collect various types of information to provide and improve our services to you:
Privacy.sec2ADesc: We use **NextAuth** for Single Sign-On (SSO) integration via Google. We collect your email address, full name, and profile picture exclusively for authentication and account identification purposes.
Privacy.sec2BDesc: Any materials you upload, including portfolio text, project links, descriptions, cover images, and embedded widgets (such as Canva, Penpot, Github).
Privacy.sec2CDesc: We automatically collect your portfolio visit logs, click interactions on your links, and page performance data to present back in your Analytics Dashboard.
Privacy.sec3Desc: The information collected is used exclusively for the following purposes:
Privacy.sec3L1: Creating, managing, and personalizing your public portfolio.
Privacy.sec3L2: Providing analytical insights on your portfolio's performance.
Privacy.sec3L3: Verifying manual payment proofs for your Pro subscription activation.
Privacy.sec3L4: Improving the SEO and global search visibility of your portfolio.
Privacy.sec4Desc: Your data is stored on cloud infrastructure managed to industry security standards. Our database operates securely, and all media assets are uploaded, optimized, and served through trusted content delivery networks (CDNs) like **Cloudinary**. We **never sell** your personal data or traffic analytics to third parties or advertisers.
Privacy.sec5Desc: Portfo.be only uses essential first-party cookies and local storage (session storage/local storage) that are strictly necessary to keep your login session active, secure data update processes, and prevent analytics manipulation (e.g., preventing double-counting of visits).
Privacy.sec6Desc: You have full control over your data:
Privacy.sec6L1: - **Access & Update:** You can edit your profile and portfolio at any time via the editor dashboard.
Privacy.sec6L2: - **Data Deletion:** You have the right to delete your account. The "Delete Account" feature in our dashboard will permanently delete your profile, all portfolios, and associated media.
Privacy.sec6L3: - **Visibility:** You determine the publication of your work and whether search engines are allowed to index your portfolio.
Privacy.sec7Desc: If you have in-depth questions about this privacy policy or wish to make requests regarding your personal data, please contact our security and privacy team at:

Guide.lesson1P1: Welcome to the definitive guide on Portfo.be's core architecture. Unlike tradisional portofolio builders that rely on fragile drag-and-drop mechanics, Portfo.be is engineered using an enterprise-grade abstraction. You don't just build a site; you manage a digital identity.
Guide.lesson1P2: The biggest mistake professionals make is breaking their live site while trying out new designs. Portfo.be solves this using an advanced Theme Editor with a built-in Draft Manager.
Guide.lesson1L1: Safe Sandboxing: Any change you make to colors, typography, or base themes is saved locally to your session state.
Guide.lesson1L2: Drafting API: Behind the scenes, the /api/appearance/drafts route securely stores your experimental UI without affecting the public-facing database.
Guide.lesson1L3: Explicit Publishing: Your audience only sees what you want them to see. Changes must be explicitly committed via the Publish pipeline.
Guide.lesson1TipDesc: You can jump straight into the Theme Editor from anywhere in the dashboard by hitting <kbd className="font-sans bg-black border border-white/20 px-2 py-1 mx-1 text-white">CMD/CTRL + E</kbd>.
Guide.lesson2P1: Portfo.be doesn't just offer templates; it provides a comprehensive Theme Engine designed to output high-performance, aesthetically striking layouts out-of-the-box.
Guide.lesson2P2: You might have noticed our platform's default aesthetic: sharp edges, stark contrast, and monospaced typography. This is known as Neo-Brutalism.
Guide.lesson2L1: No Border Radius: We strip away soft curves to project authority and precision.
Guide.lesson2L2: High Contrast Colors: Using absolute black (#000000) against stark white or vibrant accents (like our signature orange #ff9e00) ensures maximum accessibility and visual impact.
Guide.lesson2L3: Noise Filters: To prevent the design from feeling flat, our engine automatically applies an SVG fractal noise filter to backgrounds, giving them an organic, tactile texture.
Guide.lesson2P3: Under the hood, every theme modification you make updates a set of global CSS Variables. This means when you change a color in the Theme Editor, it instantly cascades across your entire site without requiring a page reload.
Guide.lesson2TipDesc: Don't be afraid of empty space. Brutalism relies heavily on whitespace to separate elements rather than drawing boxes around everything.
Guide.lesson3P1: Once your theme is set, the final step is managing your actual portfolio content. Portfo.be treats your projects with enterprise-level data integrity.
Guide.lesson3P2: Managing your case studies should feel like managing a high-end gallery, not a messy folder of JPEGs.
Guide.lesson3L1: Relational Integrity: Projects are strictly typed and relational. This prevents database foreign key errors when you delete a category or re-order your grid.
Guide.lesson3L2: Skeleton Loading: The platform utilizes Suspense boundaries and skeleton UIs to ensure a seamless, non-blocking editing experience, even when loading heavy high-res assets.
Guide.lesson3P3: Every account is instantly provisioned with a secure, isolated namespace (e.g., username.portfo.be or portfo.be/username).
Guide.lesson3L3: Middleware Edge Routing: We intercept requests at the edge to dynamically map your subdomain to your specific user ID, ensuring ultra-fast TTFB (Time to First Byte).
Guide.lesson3L4: Stealth Sitemaps: Your SEO is isolated. The platform dynamically generates sitemaps specific to your subdomain, preventing cross-tenant indexing bleed.
Guide.lesson3TipDesc: You now understand the core architecture of Portfo.be. You are ready to build.
